Fresh product detail resolved to the requested variant. Pass options as `option_\x3CName>=\x3Cvalue>` query\nparameters, for example `option_Size=M&option_Color=Black`. `relaxed` lists any option the catalog could not honor.\n
Drafting, preparing, signing and reading shopper-signed intent mandates.
Draft a mandate from the shopper's words\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Turns a plain request into structured limits for the shopper to review. Nothing is stored. Rate limited per visitor.
Build the exact mandate to sign\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Returns the mandate the shopper's device must sign and the exact `signingMessage`\n(`undo-intent-mandate-v1:\x3Csha256 of the canonical mandate JSON>`). Stateless; nothing is stored.\n
Store a signed mandate\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Re-verifies the signature, freshness, expiry and readiness, then writes the first event of the mandate's hash chain.
Get a mandate and check its integrity\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The mandate, its status, the search it permits, and a fresh check of its digest, signature and event chain.
Let Undo's agent shop inside a mandate and open a PayPal checkout that only authorizes the money.
Shop inside a mandate\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Undo's agent searches, checks the cart against the signed limits, and opens a PayPal checkout in AUTHORIZE
mode. Without a saved wallet the shopper approves at `approveUrl`; with one (and only if the mandate allows it)
the money is held straight away. One live purchase per mandate. Rate limited per visitor.
The shopper's side of a mandate an outside agent asked for.
Get a mandate request\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The draft an outside agent asked the shopper to sign, who is asking, and whether it is signed yet.
Answer, prepare or sign a mandate request\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

- `answer`: answers the agent's open questions; the draft is re-read from the new text.
- `prepare`: the exact mandate this device's key must sign.
- `sign`: stores the signed mandate; it must match the request byte for byte (same words, limits and agent).
Purchases, their undo windows, the Undo button, and the evidence to verify them.
Get an order\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The purchase, the live undo window, the mandate behind it, and its verified event chain. Each event carries its proof.
Download the evidence for an order\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Everything needed to check an order without trusting Undo: the raw hash-chained events exactly as hashed and\nthe signed mandate exactly as stored. Nothing is pre-verified, on purpose.\n
Undo a purchase\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

The Undo button. Must be signed by the mandate's shopper key over
`undo-request-v1:\x3CorderId>:\x3Csha256 hex of reason>:\x3Csha256 hex of photo bytes, or ->:\x3CrequestedAt>`.
`requestedAt` must be within 15 minutes of now. Runs the fault check, then routes the money: a void inside
the window, or a refund, merchant claim, return or human review after capture. Rate limited per visitor.
The store's view. Sandbox demo store; merchant sign-in comes with production use.
Resolve an order as the merchant\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
The merchant's side of an Undo. Sandbox only.
List agent orders\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every agent order (latest 300) with its verdict, who pays and any agent payout, plus headline numbers.
List agents and their trust scores\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every agent that has shopped here, its record and trust score with every point explained, and what the store's rules do to it.
Get the store's agent rules\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The rules the store applies to agents at checkout: block below a trust score, lengthen the undo window below a score, or accept only registered operators.
Update the store's agent rules\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">PUT\x3C/span>
Applies from the next checkout, for Undo's agent and every MCP agent. Each change is recorded in the store's event chain.
Stream the store's activity\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every step Undo records, newest first (up to 60). Pass `after` to get only events newer than that id.
